Jon: pagination note: show both manual loop (page_token) and a convenience `paginate` helper that yields items until `max_items` or exhausted. folks conflate `page_size` and `max_items`.
Maya: example for manual pagination (py): ```python
page_token = None
while True:
    resp = client.list_items(page_size=50, page_token=page_token)
    for it in resp.items:
        print(it)
    if not resp.next_page_token:
        break
    page_token = resp.next_page_token
```
Anya: async streaming primary (py): ```python
async for chunk in client.responses.stream("generate", input=prompt):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```
Anya: sync fallback snippet: ```python
for chunk in client.responses.stream("generate", input=prompt):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```
Sam: TS streaming: ```ts
for await (const part of client.responses.stream("generate", { input: prompt })) {
  process.stdout.write(part.text)
}
```
Sam: simple retry wrapper for TS: ```ts
async function withRetries(fn, opts = { retries: 3 }) {
  for (let i = 0; i < opts.retries; i++) {
    try { return await fn() } catch (e) { if (i === opts.retries - 1) throw e }
  }
}
```
Leo: Go sketch for streaming: ```go
stream, _ := client.StreamGenerate(ctx, prompt)
for msg := range stream.Ch {
  fmt.Print(msg.Text)
}
```
Leo: and a helper to drain stream into full messages: ```go
for {
  m, ok := stream.Next()
  if !ok { break }
  fmt.Println(m.Text)
}
```
